meta.title: BeTaxed — Social Security savings
meta.description: Find unrealized Social Security savings for your company. No recipe.

start.headline: There is unrealized Social Security saving in your company.
start.lead: Upload the extract you generate from Segurança Social. We show two totals — what is already within reach, and what could follow. We do not teach the method.
start.needAccount: You do not need an account to see the totals.
start.preferUpload: I would rather upload the file first

dropzone.title: Drop the Segurança Social extract
dropzone.hint: CSV or Excel. One workbook, or both files (employment and contracts).

result.headline: There is value left on the table. Not a map of how to take it.
result.lead: If you continue, we run the process with you. If you decline, we delete the extract and these figures.
result.declineConfirm: This permanently deletes the file and the totals.

teaser.potentialNote: If you stay with us through the process.

converted.headline: {name} is with us.
converted.lead: The same totals are stored. Next: contracts, monthly declarations, and the work — in the workspace.

declined.headline: The extract and totals were deleted.
declined.lead: Nothing stays with us. You can start again whenever you like.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.needFile: Choose the Segurança Social extract (CSV or Excel).
errors.needAuthStart: To sign in first, enter email and password.
errors.needAuthContinue: Create an account (or sign in) to continue.
errors.parseFailed: This file could not be read. Use the official employment and contracts extract.
errors.authWeak: Password must be at least 6 characters.

verbose.lead: People in the extract, with age and how they sit against the hiring-benefit regime. Local verbose only.
verbose.name: Name

howCodes.NOW_UNUSED: Already on a permanent contract. Unused reduction. {months} months left of 60.
howCodes.POTENTIAL_CONVERT: On a term contract and in the age band. Convert to permanent to open the regime.
howCodes.SKIP_AGE: Older than 30 at the permanent-contract clock. The regime does not apply.
howCodes.SKIP_TSU_REDUCED: TSU already looks reduced. Nothing unused here.
howCodes.SKIP_WINDOW: The 60-month window from the permanent start is used up.
howCodes.SKIP_NO_DOB: No date of birth in the extract, so age cannot be checked.
howCodes.SKIP_NO_PAY: No open pay period in the extract.
howCodes.SKIP_CONTRACT: Contract type is outside the hiring-benefit set.

workspace.needSession: We could not open this workspace.

kpi.potentialMonthlyHint: If you stay with us through the process
kpi.potentialWindowHint: If you stay with us through the process

next.title: Next in the workspace
next.lead: Same totals as the reading. The rest of the loop comes in later tickets.

next.declarations: Monthly Segurança Social files — not in this screen yet.
